title: Worklog
content:
Below is my detailed worklog across the 8 weeks of the First Cloud AI Journey internship program:
Week 1: Overview of AWS architecture and create a practice account
Week 2: Learn about AWS Core Services: EC2, S3, IAM
Week 3: Learn about AWS Networking: VPC, Subnet, Internet Gateway
Week 4: Learn about AWS Lambda and Serverless model
Week 5: Learn about AWS CloudWatch and CloudTrail
Week 6: Learn about Elastic Load Balancer (ELB) and Auto Scaling
Week 7: Learn about AWS ECS and Docker basics
Week 8: Implement a comprehensive project on AWS

title: Week 2 Worklog
content: Week 2 Objectives: Learn about AWS Core Services: EC2, S3, IAM. Complete fundamental lessons and hands-on practices on AWS Cloud. Tasks to be carried out this week: Day Task Start Date End Date References Mon Explore AWS Core Services: EC2, S3, IAM 05/05/2026 05/05/2026 AWS Cloud Journey Tue Perform hands-on labs with EC2 and S3 06/05/2026 08/05/2026 AWS Cloud Journey Wed Study theoretical concepts related to Cloud Computing 08/05/2026 11/05/2026 AWS Documentation Achievements for Week 2: Understood AWS core architecture and configured cloud resources successfully. Acquired fundamental cloud concepts and completed introductory modules.

title: Week 3 Worklog

Successfully built an isolated VPC network environment for cloud resources.

title: Week 4 Worklog
content: Week 4 Objectives: Learn AWS Lambda and the Serverless paradigm. Practice writing event-driven Lambda functions. title: Week 5 Worklog
content: Week 5 Objectives: Learn AWS CloudWatch (monitoring) and CloudTrail (auditing & activity tracking). Set up monitoring metrics, alarms, and audit log tracking. Successfully configured automated alerting for resource utilization thresholds.

title: Week 6 Worklog
